modules.title: Job contracts and identity
modules.nextAction: Persist tenants, operator/client roles, immutable quote revisions, currency and minimum gross margin. Bind the customer to a specific job and version.

modules.title: Cost attribution
modules.nextAction: Implement append-only direct labor, infra and provider expense entries and shared allocation. Surface the unallocated residual and evidence for adjustments.

modules.title: Reservation and concurrency
modules.nextAction: Build atomic job-budget reservation and denial reason codes. Validate quote revision, expiry and idempotency payload digest.

modules.title: Paid call dispatch
modules.nextAction: Bind the winning reservation to the payment-session cap, provider and rail. Persist a dispatch outbox before invoking the provider and save opaque provider references.

modules.title: Receipt and credit reconciliation
modules.nextAction: Ingest a provider statement, verify merchant and amount, replace the held estimate with the actual cost, and permit evidence-linked corrections.

modules.title: Delivery and close
modules.nextAction: Capture artifact digest, customer acceptance, realized revenue, expense completeness and immutable close versions. Permit post-close corrections via a new version.

modules.title: Operator console and exports
modules.nextAction: Expose denial shortfall, reservation owners, unallocated costs, acceptance and adjustment lineage. Generate per-job CSV and a reconciliation view.

modules.title: Restart and pilot proof
modules.nextAction: Implement recovery harness for two simultaneous workers, an ambiguous dispatch and a late receipt. Replay a consented pilot record through the normal HTTP and UI paths.
